gaps.expected: Ignore invalid Accept candidates when a valid JSON:API candidate remains.
gaps.current: 406 for both candidate orders and unsupported-extension fallback.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Parse candidates independently in ContentNegotiationSubscriber.

gaps.expected: Treat q-values as HTTP metadata; respect unacceptable q=0.
gaps.current: q=1 and q=0.8 return 406; q=0 already returns 406.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Separate Accept quality values from JSON:API media parameters.

gaps.expected: Infer add target from data.type without ref/href. Domain-invalid title-only articles reach 422 validation.
gaps.current: 400 missing target before domain validation.
gaps.bundle_change_required: AtomicValidator target inference.

gaps.expected: Infer update target from data.type and data.id.
gaps.current: 400 missing target.
gaps.bundle_change_required: AtomicValidator target inference.

gaps.expected: Reject ref with both id and lid.
gaps.current: 200 accepts the id and ignores lid.
gaps.bundle_change_required: AtomicRequestParser exclusive identifier validation.

gaps.expected: Return generated IDs and resolve lids after persisting generated-ID resources.
gaps.current: 400 Unable to resolve resource identifier for persisted model, before operation flush.
gaps.bundle_change_required: AddHandler/OperationDispatcher flush and lid resolution ordering.

gaps.expected: Accept same-origin absolute and path-relative URI references.
gaps.current: 400 rejects absolute URLs and references without leading slash.
gaps.bundle_change_required: AtomicValidator URI-reference resolution and same-origin checks.

gaps.expected: Reject href with unrecognized trailing path segments.
gaps.current: 200 ignores trailing path segments and removes the resource.
gaps.bundle_change_required: AtomicValidator must consume and validate the entire href.

gaps.expected: Serialize empty atomic result entries as JSON objects.
gaps.current: 200 emits [] entries instead of {}.
gaps.bundle_change_required: ResultBuilder empty object serialization.

gaps.expected: Return each operation representation at its position in the batch.
gaps.current: Earlier update result reflects the final mutable entity state.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Snapshot operation outcomes before processing later mutations.

gaps.expected: Apply read-only operation policy to atomic resource updates.
gaps.current: 422 serializer rejection instead of policy 403; operation authorization is bypassed.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Atomic execution must enforce ResourceOperation restrictions.

gaps.expected: Apply the configured client-generated ID policy to atomic creates.
gaps.current: 500 attempts to assign a string to a generated integer ID.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Atomic AddHandler must apply WriteConfig client-ID policy.

gaps.expected: Use /atomic:operations/N/data/... pointers in atomic errors.
gaps.current: Errors contain ordinary /data/... pointers.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Rebase write/validation error pointers onto their atomic operation.

gaps.expected: Recognize the enabled Atomic extension with strict global negotiation.
gaps.current: 415 rejects all extensions before AtomicController. A public channel isolates Atomic execution tests.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Connect enabled extensions to global media-type negotiation.

gaps.expected: Atomic negotiation rejects incorrect base media types and unsupported Content-Type parameters.
gaps.current: AtomicController accepts text/plain with atomic ext and JSON:API atomic with charset.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Use a shared structured media-type parser for Atomic requests.

gaps.expected: Evaluate write preconditions before mutation; matching GET ETag permits a write.
gaps.current: Valid If-Match gets 412; stale/missing conditions return 412/428 after changes have already persisted.
gaps.bundle_change_required: CachePreconditionsSubscriber currently runs at kernel.response; move write checks before persistence.

gaps.expected: Resolve Last-Modified from the configured updatedAt field.
gaps.current: Header uses current wall-clock time instead of the entity timestamp.
gaps.bundle_change_required: LastModifiedResolver must use resource metadata/configuration.

gaps.expected: Map unique violations to JSON:API 409 and roll back the transaction.
gaps.current: 500 escapes from transaction/flush; rollback checks themselves pass.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Map database exceptions raised inside DoctrineTransactionManager and Atomic dispatch.

gaps.expected: Report FK restriction as JSON:API 422 and retain the parent.
gaps.current: 500 from an unmapped Doctrine FK exception.
gaps.bundle_change_required: DatabaseErrorMapper integration at transaction flush/delete.

gaps.expected: Point missing related identifiers at the public linkage id member.
gaps.current: 404 pointer omits /data/id or refers to the relationship rather than its identifier.
gaps.bundle_change_required: RelationshipResolver and relationship endpoint error pointers.

gaps.expected: Use consistent 409 for linkage resource-type conflicts in ordinary create/update requests.
gaps.current: Relationship endpoints use 409, resource writes use 422.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Unify resource-write and relationship endpoint type-conflict validation.

gaps.expected: Reject unknown relationship writes with 400.
gaps.current: 201 silently discards unknown relationship names.
gaps.bundle_change_required: InputDocumentValidator relationship whitelist.

gaps.expected: Reject null on required author with a client validation error.
gaps.current: 500 DB not-null violation when clearing required relationship.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Validate required relationship metadata before persistence.

gaps.expected: Provide a related link in the linkage document as an application navigation contract.
gaps.current: The resource relationship object has related, but its standalone linkage document omits it.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Linkage document navigation links.

gaps.expected: HEAD sends GET-compatible ETag and an empty body.
gaps.current: Bodies are empty, but HEAD ETags differ from GET for all route categories.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Generate validators from GET representation before stripping HEAD body.

gaps.expected: Generated OPTIONS routes execute and report cardinality-aware Allow methods.
gaps.current: 500: OptionsController has constructor arguments but is not registered in the container.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Register OptionsController and exclude POST/DELETE for to-one relationships.

gaps.expected: Support registered neq and documented ne not-equals operators.
gaps.current: neq is rejected by parser; ne reaches an unknown compiler operator and returns 500.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Align FilterParser, operator registry and filter whitelist.

gaps.expected: Compile supported between filters and reject extra operands.
gaps.current: 500: Between AST is unsupported by DoctrineFilterCompiler.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Handle Between AST and require exactly two operands.

gaps.expected: Compile isnull true/false through configured nullable field aliases.
gaps.current: 500: NullCheck AST is unsupported by DoctrineFilterCompiler.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Handle NullCheck AST and resolve attribute aliases.

gaps.expected: Execute PostgreSQL ilike with the app's installed DBAL 4.
gaps.current: 500: PostgreSQL platform no longer has getName().
gaps.bundle_change_required: Update Doctrine ILikeFunction platform detection for DBAL 4.

gaps.expected: Define empty IN as no matches and empty NOT IN as all matches.
gaps.current: 500 for empty string operands on the integer field.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Validate/coerce set operands; compile deliberate empty-set semantics.

gaps.expected: Translate external attribute aliases for filter and sort.
gaps.current: 500: published-at is emitted as a DQL path instead of publishedAt.
gaps.bundle_change_required: ResourceMetadata.resolveFieldPath must map attribute names as well as relationships.

gaps.expected: Reject malformed page lists and report source.parameter=page.
gaps.current: page[]=1 succeeds; scalar page error uses a different source parameter.
gaps.bundle_change_required: QueryParser pagination member shape validation.

gaps.expected: Reject invalid operand objects/types and excessive filter depth at HTTP boundary.
gaps.current: Object operand and deep groups succeed; invalid integer operand leaks a DB 500.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Bound and type-check parsed filter operands before Doctrine.

gaps.expected: Provide a stable nonempty title for query errors.
gaps.current: Unknown filter field response has code/status/source but no title.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Complete ErrorMapper title mapping for query whitelist errors.

gaps.expected: Report malformed to-one resource linkage as JSON:API 400 with public data pointer.
gaps.current: 500 for array linkage in a resource create document.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Validate resource relationship cardinality/shape before resolving.

gaps.expected: When include is requested and the nullable relationship is empty, emit included: [].
gaps.current: The included member is omitted.
gaps.bundle_change_required: DocumentBuilder requested-but-empty include handling.

gaps.expected: Accept empty attributes object in a partial PATCH.
gaps.current: 400: associative decoding conflates {} with [].
gaps.bundle_change_required: Preserve JSON object/array distinction in request validation.

gaps.expected: Apply per-type default relationship count profile.
gaps.current: No count metadata for tags without Accept profile; negotiated profile works.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Per-type ProfileContext activation in DocumentBuilder.

gaps.expected: Negotiated soft-delete profile excludes archived categories on collection/item reads.
gaps.current: Archived categories remain visible.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Integrate soft-delete query hooks with Doctrine collection and item reads.

gaps.expected: Negotiated audit profile advances and persists updatedAt on writes.
gaps.current: Timestamp remains the seeded value; write hooks are not integrated.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Integrate audit WriteHook into resource processors/controllers.

gaps.expected: Implicit ID tiebreaker keeps tied title pagination deterministic after updates.
gaps.current: Tied rows reverse after an unrelated row update.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Append a stable identifier ordering when absent from client sorting.

gaps.expected: Client-supplied UUID strings create resources with a typed Symfony Uuid identifier through ordinary POST and Atomic add.
gaps.current: Both requests return 500 because client ID assignment passes a string to setId(Uuid). Constructor-generated UUID objects and UUID string identifiers work.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Doctrine processors must convert client identifiers using mapped Doctrine/Serializer types before PropertyAccessor assignment.

gaps.expected: A malformed identifier in a UUID resource URL produces a JSON:API 400 client error.
gaps.current: GET /api/newsletters/not-a-uuid returns 500 when Doctrine UuidType rejects the identifier. A valid nonexistent UUID correctly returns 404.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Validate mapped UUID identifiers at the HTTP boundary or translate Doctrine UID conversion errors into JSON:API client errors.

gaps.expected: A tagged public ProfileInterface service can use required constructor injection and the HTTP application still boots.
gaps.current: Container validation reports the registered profile as missing when it has a required constructor dependency; HTTP cannot start.
gaps.why_bundle: Symfony service construction is part of the public extension integration. Application policies need injected context; they must not be forced into service-location or mutable global state.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Support dependency-injected profile services during validation; obtain static descriptors without constructing unconfigured application services.

gaps.area: Production ownership scope across graph reads
gaps.expected: Application-owned Article scope applies before pagination to INDEX, related collections, includes and relationship linkage; foreign objects and identifiers are not exposed.
gaps.current: ResourceRepository decoration scopes INDEX/SHOW and DTO projections, but related collections, includes and linkage bypass that scope and expose Grace articles to editor A.
gaps.why_bundle: Choosing visibility is application policy. Consistently invoking a public query-scope extension across every generated graph read is bundle infrastructure; post-filtering hydrated pages or replacing include/linkage engines would hide the missing seam.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Provide one mandatory resource query/visibility extension used for root queries, relationship pagination, identifier discovery and includes, independent of client profile negotiation.

gaps.expected: A custom handler can serialize a registered non-Doctrine aggregate resource with operations=[] using its custom GET route, without requiring fictitious generated CRUD routes.
gaps.current: CustomRouteResult::resource attempts to generate jsonapi.author-publishing-statistics.show although SHOW is disabled; the aggregate endpoint returns 500.
gaps.why_bundle: The aggregate SQL and authorization are application-owned. Resource serialization and link generation must support the public custom-route/read-model contract without forcing unrelated persistence routes.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Support canonical/self link metadata for custom-route-only resources or safely serialize resources without a generated SHOW route.

gaps.expected: The bundle honors effective Symfony Serializer metadata, including configured environment-specific YAML write groups; original wide-surface test contracts remain executable while publishing uses attribute-only safe groups.
gaps.current: Symfony debug:serializer reports articles:write for the configured test fields, but generated JSON:API writes reject views/status/published-at as extra attributes (422). Five original desired round-trip/workflow assertions fail without being changed.
gaps.why_bundle: Resolving effective Symfony Serializer input metadata is generic transport integration. Consumers should not need to duplicate serializer mapping in bundle internals or replace generic deserialization. Production attribute groups already enforce the safe surface correctly.
gaps.bundle_change_required: Use effective Symfony serializer metadata consistently when determining allowed input fields, including external mapping paths and inherited metadata.

gaps.expected: The original mixed-manager batch assertion expects 422 for invalid Article title and verifies preceding MySQL Comment changes do not persist.
gaps.current: The installed provider rejects the multi-manager boundary with JSON:API 409 unsupported-transaction-boundary before business validation; the preceding Comment state is unchanged. The safety assertion passes and the 422 status assertion remains failing.
gaps.why_bundle: This records an existing consumer contract against the installed single-EntityManager transaction provider, not a JSON:API violation or a loss of Atomic safety. Distributed/multi-connection atomic commit is outside the application example. The desired error precedence remains explicit instead of silently changing an existing assertion.
gaps.bundle_change_required: No transaction-safety fix is inferred: rejection is safe. Document unsupported-boundary error precedence and the single-manager contract; any future broader provider must preserve rollback assertions.
